title: Multiplex PCR-SSP for SNP Analysis
author: Gabriela GCK Canalli Kretzschmar
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.p5sdq6e

steps.title: Prepare and label microtubes
steps.instruction: Label four microtubes per sample as MIX 1, MIX 2, MIX 3, and MIX 4 according to the specific SNP combinations. Keep microtubes on ice.

steps.title: Assemble PCR reaction mix
steps.instruction: Add the following reagents to each mix microtube. Prepare a 10% excess volume for each mix.

substeps.instruction: Add Ultrapure Water
Add 1x Coral Buffer (containing 1.5 mM MgCl2)
Add 0.2 mM dNTP
Add 0.5 mM MgCl2 (to reach a total concentration of 2 mM MgCl2 per mix)
Add HGH control primers (0.08 µM): 0.064 µl forward (5’-TGCCTTCCCAACCATTCCCTTA) and 0.064 µl reverse (5’-CCACTCACGGATTTCTGTTGTGTTTC)

steps.title: Add specific SNP primers
steps.instruction: Add the specific primers to the corresponding mixes based on the SNP targets.

substeps.instruction: For in21/ex22 targets: add 0.144 µl of each primer (F and R) at 0.18 µM
For in37/in37 targets: add 0.32 µl of each primer (F and R) at 0.4 µM
Refer to sequences: rs3849266 (F: CTGATGGCTTGGGGTA T/C), rs2274567 (R: CTCAATCTGCATTGATCCA C/T), rs4844610 (F: CTACACAAAACAGCCTTGT A/C), rs12034383 (R: AGATGTCCATGCCTTAA C/T)

steps.title: Add DNA and Polymerase
steps.instruction: Complete the reaction mixture while keeping the plate cold.

substeps.instruction: Add an aliquot of DNA sample to each tube
Add Taq DNA polymerase (0.3 Units/ul)
Briefly vortex and centrifuge for several seconds

steps.title: Aliquot and seal samples
steps.instruction: Distribute the mix into the four reaction tubes for each sample to a final volume of 8 µl per tube.

substeps.instruction: Close tubes securely
Centrifuge for several seconds

steps.title: Perform Thermal Cycling
steps.instruction: Place tubes in the thermocycler and run the following program:

substeps.instruction: Initial denaturation: 94°C for 5 min and 20 s
35 cycles consisting of: 94°C for 20 s, annealing step, and 72°C for 40 s
Annealing temperatures: 63°C for the first 6 cycles, 61°C for the next 16 cycles, and 59°C for the final 11 cycles
